guide.summary: A light-powered cell that makes its own food from carbon dioxide.
guide.biology: Algae photosynthesise: with light, carbon dioxide and minerals they build their bodies and release oxygen.
guide.rules: Lives in water only and does not swim. Turns carbon dioxide into half body and half sugar, releasing oxygen, in proportion to local light. Needs mineral nutrients to grow. Prey for Amoeba, Ciliate and Rotifer; the only host of Hitcher.
guide.example: Shade part of the dish and compare how fast Sunbeads grow in the light and in the dark.
